newsitem.title: USA: Jan Bell stake raised by Tweedy Browne.
newsitem.headline: Jan Bell stake raised by Tweedy Browne.

text.p: A group led by Tweedy Browne Company LP said Friday it raised its stake in Jan Bell Marketing Inc to 1,615,888 common shares of 6.53 percent.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include buying 90,408 common between Jan 17 and Feb 21 at $2 to $2.25 a share.
Jan Bell, based in Sunrise, Fla., designs, makes, markets and distributes fine quality gold, diamond, gemstone and other jewelry, watches, fragnances, sunglasses, writing instruments and giftware.
